knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Without an approved method, scraping or strong solvent can damage new stone.
Uncured coatings can be damaged by a product that suits the cured surface.
A test informs compatibility; it does not replace the specification or SDS.

practicalCriteria: Builds a surface schedule listing substrate, coating, approved method, prohibited tools and defect escalation.
Records a simulated adhesive residue and does not scrape or use strong solvent.
Selects an approved non-damaging technique for a simulated delicate surface.
passRule: Surface schedule complete, residue recorded, no scraping or strong solvent, and approved technique selected. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Scraping or strong solvent used without an approved method
Untested product used on an uncured surface
